title: Young Volunteers
topic: ข่าว/ผลสำรวจ
lines: Volunteering is becoming more popular among young Thais. A recent survey
found that 45 percent of people aged 15 to 25 had volunteered at least
once in the past year, up from 30 percent five years ago. The most common
activities were teaching children, cleaning beaches and helping at
When asked why **they** volunteer, most young people said they wanted to
help society. **Many** also admitted that volunteering looks good on
university and job applications. Interestingly, those who volunteered
for practical reasons were just as likely to continue as **those** who
Organizations say young volunteers bring energy and new skills, especially
in social media and technology. However, **some** complain that young people
often join for one day and do not return. To solve **this**, several groups
now offer short, regular projects that fit around students' schedules.
